title: AAC Provider Instance 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Provider Instance schema and its serialized data contract.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this AAC provider instance.

ComponentId.description: Stable identifier of the AAC component associated with this AAC provider instance.

ProviderDefinitionId.description: Identifier of the provider definition from which this provider instance is created.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this AAC provider instance.

ImplementationClass.description: Technology implementation class used to instantiate this provider.

ConfigurationSchema.description: Canonical schema reference used to validate this configuration.

Configuration.description: Configuration values supplied to this AAC provider instance.

State.description: Lifecycle or storage state of this AAC provider instance.

Capabilities.description: Lists the capabilities associated with this AAC provider instance.

Versions.description: Lists the versions supported or selected by this capability.

AccessMode.description: Declares the permitted read/write access mode for this provider instance or resource.
